# porch_role_assignment (Resource)

Grants a role to a user, group or service account at tenant, resource-type or resource scope, optionally under a condition policy and with an expiry. Needs `role:manage`; delegated administrators may only grant roles whose permissions they hold. Assignments are immutable: every change replaces them. Import with `<tenant>/<assignment_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Kids may use the media apps, but only during the day.
resource "porch_role_assignment" "kids_media" {
  tenant              = porch_tenant.smiths.id
  subject_type        = "group"
  subject_id          = porch_group.kids.id
  role_id             = porch_role.media_viewer.id
  condition_policy_id = porch_policy.daytime.id
}

# Access to one application only (resource scope).
resource "porch_role_assignment" "ada_whoami" {
  tenant              = porch_tenant.smiths.id
  subject_type        = "user"
  subject_id          = porch_tenant_member.ada.user_id
  role_id             = porch_role.media_viewer.id
  scope_type          = "resource"
  scope_resource_type = "app"
  scope_resource_id   = porch_application.whoami.id
  expires_at          = "2030-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (String) ID (or slug) of the role. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `subject_id` (String) ID of the user (a member of the tenant), group or service account. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `subject_type` (String) `user`, `group` or `service_account`. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `tenant` (String) ID or slug of the tenant that owns this object. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `condition_policy_id` (String) ID of a `condition` policy that must evaluate to true for the grant to apply. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `expires_at` (String) Expiry time (RFC 3339, in the future). Changing it forces a new resource.
- `scope_resource_id` (String) Resource (or application) ID for `resource` scope. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `scope_resource_type` (String) Resource type for `resource_type` and `resource` scopes (`app` for applications). Changing it forces a new resource.
- `scope_type` (String) `tenant` (default), `resource_type` or `resource`. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Assignment ID (`asg_…`).
- `source` (String) Origin of the assignment (`manual`, …).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import porch_role_assignment.kids_media <tenant>/<assignment_id>
```
